festivals.name: Outside Lands 2026
festivals.why: Rüfüs Du Sol + The xx headline the on-taste end; Charli xcx, The Strokes, Turnstile, Empire of the Sun broaden it. ~2 months out, travel weekend. 3-day GA from ~$569.

festivals.name: Daisy Chain Fields (Olivia Rodrigo)
festivals.location: Great Park Live, Irvine (OC — ~45 mi, worth the drive)
festivals.why: Olivia Rodrigo's first festival — a one-day, all-women lineup (Chappell Roan, Doechii, Mitski, The Breeders, Bikini Kill, Garbage, Santigold + special guests Stevie Nicks, Karen O, Sarah McLachlan), 100% of net proceeds to women/girls nonprofits. Off the core house/techno lane, but a marquee must-know — and squarely on-taste for the Lori profile (she tracks Olivia Rodrigo + Mitski). Tickets via Front Gate; from $250.

festivals.name: CRSSD Festival — Fall 2026
festivals.why: SD is a drive, but this is festival-tier and on-taste — Disclosure, Chris Lake, Groove Armada (DJ set), Helena Hauff, Ben UFO, I Hate Models, Mathame, Carlita, salute. House/ techno/melodic, European lean, waterfront, 21+. NOTE: same weekend as Portola (SF) — can't do both; pick one.

festivals.name: Portola 2026
festivals.why: THE one for you — electronic-forward with DESPACIO (James Murphy + 2ManyDJs sound system), Four Tet, Soulwax, Groove Armada, DJ Shadow, Fatboy Slim, Skepta, plus Robyn, Tiësto, Swedish House Mafia. European/house energy in a warehouse-pier setting. 2-day ~$380.

festivals.name: Coachella 2027
festivals.why: Advance GA already sold out (~$549–599); lineup typically drops Sept 2026–Jan 2027. Worth tracking the lineup announce to decide if a resale is worth it.

festivals.name: GALA Festival (London) — 2027 edition
festivals.why: Quintessential European house/disco day-fest (2026: Seth Troxler, Todd Terje, Call Super, DJ Seinfeld). On-taste, but not timely — only bubble up when 2027 presale/lineup drops.

artist_notes.note: Sonic Youth co-founder now several solo albums deep into a genuinely strange run — industrial-tinged, spoken-word noise-rock, not a legacy-act victory lap.

artist_notes.name: Sarah Register
artist_notes.note: LA experimental guitarist who plays in Gordon's live band and co-produced her Grammy-nominated 'The Collective' — cut her teeth in NYC avant-pop duo Talk Normal; also a Grammy-nominated mastering engineer (Black Midi, Faye Webster).

artist_notes.note: UK-born, LA-based rapper/artist — thin public footprint beyond opener billings; a wildcard support slot.

enrichment.description: Sonic Youth co-founder Kim Gordon brings her noise-rock solo project to Pacific Electric, with Sarah Register and Sleepie Louie opening.

events.title: Heat Advisory: Unofficial Hard Summer Afters Day 2 (21+)

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian tech-house export, Solotoko boss — huge festival draw, big-room but genuinely well-selected house.

artist_notes.name: 2hollis
artist_notes.note: LA-raised rage-rap/hyperpop artist on Interscope — genre-blurring pop/rap/EDM chaos, not a house/techno name.

artist_notes.name: Frost Children
artist_notes.note: NYC sibling duo splicing hyperpop, EDM, Jersey club and bloghouse into overclocked pop — festival-pop chaos more than a DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Snow Strippers
artist_notes.note: Detroit-formed electroclash duo doing bleary electro-pop shot through with witch house and hardstyle — indie-sleaze revival energy.

artist_notes.name: underscores
artist_notes.note: Genre-hopping hyperpop/indie/dubstep producer (April Harper Grey) — a real, well-reviewed act, but outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: MCR-T
artist_notes.note: Berlin rapper/producer who raps live over a hip-hop/hard-techno/ghettotech hybrid — a different texture than a straight DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Oppidan
artist_notes.note: Rising UK garage producer blending 2-step with 4x4 NUKG and bass — the garage-leaning name on an otherwise bass/EDM-heavy bill.

artist_notes.name: Ranger Trucco
artist_notes.note: Michigan tech-house producer/vocalist, Space Yacht signee — clean, warbling tech-house with sung hooks.

artist_notes.name: Andy C
artist_notes.note: UK drum & bass legend, RAM Records boss — outside the house/techno lane but a genuine, decades-deep DJ talent if you catch a set.

artist_notes.name: Knock2
artist_notes.note: US producer straddling bass music and pop-leaning electronic — big festival-stage energy, outside the house/techno lane.

artist_notes.name: Sammy Virji
artist_notes.note: UK garage/bassline producer at the center of the current UKG resurgence.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal electro-house institution (Turbo Recordings) — tongue-in-cheek, disco-inflected electro; a real name for the older end of this bill.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Polish DJ/producer on the harder, rave-leaning end of techno — Bicep's Fabric label, T4T LUV NRG co-founder; a genuinely respected underground name amid the festival billing.

artist_notes.name: Boys Noize
artist_notes.note: Berlin electro/techno veteran (Alex Ridha) — distorted, industrial-leaning club music going back to the mid-2000s Boysnoize Records run; still a reliably weird, high-energy set.

enrichment.curator_note: Amelie Lens, VTSS and Boys Noize are the real techno/tech-house draw inside a lineup that's mostly festival bass and hyperpop-adjacent acts (Frost Children, Snow Strippers, underscores, 2hollis) — free RSVP makes it low-risk to just show up for their windows and skip the rest.
enrichment.description: Free unofficial Hard Summer afters at Hollywood Park Grounds spanning techno (Amelie Lens, VTSS) to festival bass/EDM and hyperpop-adjacent acts.

verdict.why: Even with Amelie Lens and Andy C on the bill, this is a sprawling EDM day-party in Inglewood — festival-bass chaos far from home, none of the live-band or roots energy she's here for.

enrichment.curator_note: Free RSVP industry showcase at Beatport's LA HQ during HARD Summer weekend — DJ Seinfeld's hazy lo-fi house next to salute's punchier stuff is a solid pairing for a freebie, just don't expect a proper club room.

events.organizers: All Day All Night Events, Safra

artist_notes.name: EMBRZ
artist_notes.note: Dublin producer (Jack Casey) making atmospheric, vocal-forward melodic house — signed to Lane 8's This Never Happened label; downtempo-leaning and emotive rather than peak-time.

enrichment.curator_note: A rooftop sunset set from a This Never Happened-orbit artist is squarely the golden-hour-groove lane — EMBRZ leans dreamier and more vocal than a straight house DJ, good for the early slot rather than the whole night.
enrichment.description: Sunset rooftop set (5pm) at Harbor House DTLA with Dublin melodic-house producer EMBRZ.

verdict.why: Sunset rooftop melodic house is the most live-music-friendly electronic format — EMBRZ is polished and emotive rather than peak-time, but it's still a DJ set; fine rather than compelling.

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Isaac Carter, Harrison BDP, Lubelski
events.detail: Focusing on feel-good house, this intimate warehouse party is a dancers-first event designed for those who appreciate close-knit crowds.

artist_notes.name: Isaac Carter
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer, vocal-led deep house on his own Ochi imprint — championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison and Seth Troxler; UK-club lineage (Chicago/Detroit roots filtered through contemporary UK dance).

artist_notes.name: Lubelski
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Jake Lubell) making analog, vinyl-informed house with a wide festival footprint (Lightning in a Bottle, Desert Hearts, Dirtybird Campout) — eclectic and percussive rather than a strict selector.

enrichment.curator_note: Isaac Carter's UK deep-house pedigree (that Ben UFO/Seth Troxler co-sign carries real weight) makes this a stronger TBA-DTLA afterhours than the billing alone suggests — a legit late-night option once Harrison BDP fills in the middle.
enrichment.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (starts midnight) with London deep-house producer Isaac Carter, Welsh DJ Harrison BDP, and LA's Lubelski.

verdict.why: Isaac Carter has real deep-house cred (Ben UFO, Joy Orbison territory), but a TBA warehouse rave past midnight is firmly the wrong format for a live-music-first listener.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

enrichment.curator_note: This is literally Masha Mar and Heidi Lawden's own party, and Lovefingers on the bill is a genuine ESP Institute/Balearic-disco booking — basically the rooftop-groove lane stretched into a full day-into-night event.

artist_notes.note: LA disco-house DJ duo (TK & Tavish) — dynamic, acid-tinged dancefloor energy; played Glastonbury, Love International and Sunset Campout, one half rooted in '90s SF underground, the other in Venice/Ocean Park hip-hop-to-house.

artist_notes.name: Bears In Space
artist_notes.note: The LA collective behind this very party — Chris Bowen and Victor Rodriguez have run it since 2009, one of the city's longest-standing queer disco/house day parties, historically pulling in guests like DJ Harvey and Horse Meat Disco.

artist_notes.name: Perfect Lovers
artist_notes.note: LA DJ (Celice Monnette) and co-founder of the Mexico City/LA queer warehouse party @pordetroitmx and the Muy Muy label — house and techno with a queer-community throughline.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

enrichment.curator_note: This is the real thing, not a knockoff — Bears in Space has been Silver Lake's queer disco-house day party since 2009 (DJ Harvey and Horse Meat Disco have both played it), walkable from home, and this bill is literally the people who built it — Chris Bowen and Victor Rodriguez themselves, plus Perfect Lovers.
enrichment.description: Bears in Space's recurring queer disco/house day party in the Akbar parking lot, with founders Chris Bowen and Victor Rodriguez, Warehouse Preservation Society, Perfect Lovers, and Stacy Christine.

events.title: Lane 8, Sultan + Shepard, Yotto, Kasbo, Massane, Qrion, Ashibah, Grigore

artist_notes.name: Sultan + Shepard
artist_notes.note: Montreal-born, now LA-based progressive/melodic house duo (Ossama Al Sarraf & Ned Shepard) — Grammy-nominated for their Bruno Mars remix; steady, emotive mid-tempo sets since the early 2010s remix era rather than an underground name.

artist_notes.name: Kasbo
artist_notes.note: Gothenburg producer on ODESZA's Foreign Family Collective — soulful, melody-rich electronic that leans future-bass/downtempo; softer and poppier than the rest of this bill.

artist_notes.name: Massane
artist_notes.note: French melodic-house producer and guitarist — debut EP and album on Lane 8's This Never Happened, plus a release on mau5trap. Guitar-textured, emotive melodic house that sits right next to the Anjunadeep/Lane 8 end of the spectrum.

artist_notes.name: Qrion
artist_notes.note: Japan-born, Austin-based producer on Anjunadeep — shimmering, emotive melodic house; DJ Mag's 2021 Future Star, two albums deep with the label.

artist_notes.name: Ashibah
artist_notes.note: Danish-Egyptian DJ/vocalist on Defected and Get Physical — deep/tech house built around her own live vocals; more pop-house crossover than underground selector.

enrichment.curator_note: Lane 8 and Yotto anchor this fine, but it's a San Diego waterfront day-into-night — factor in the drive. The rest of the bill (Sultan + Shepard, Kasbo, Massane, Qrion) skews toward the melodic/emotive end rather than anything harder.
enrichment.description: CRSSD-affiliated melodic/progressive house day-into-night at San Diego's Waterfront Park, headlined by Lane 8 and Yotto with Sultan + Shepard, Kasbo, Massane, Qrion, Ashibah and Grigore.

events.detail: Post Present Medium    25 Year Anniversary Celebration, Night III…      Abe Vigoda    Callahan & Witscher ‍  ‍ (NYC)    Debt Rag ‍  ‍ (Olympia, WA)    The Intima ‍  ‍ (Portland, OR)    DREAM_MEGA      Plus DJ Cate Kennan!      8:00 pm    Advance $20 single day tickets available    here   . artist_notes.name: Abe Vigoda
artist_notes.note: LA experimental/'tropical punk' band from the mid-2000s Smell scene, on Post Present Medium — jittery, humid, post-punk-meets-tropicalia; this run is a reunion set for the label's anniversary.

artist_notes.name: Callahan & Witscher
artist_notes.note: NYC duo of two veteran underground experimentalists (Jack Callahan, aka die Reihe; Jeff Witscher, aka Rene Hell) whose new project is a surprising, hooky pivot toward songs after years of noise/ambient work.

artist_notes.name: Debt Rag
artist_notes.note: Olympia, WA punk trio (former members of Grass Widow and Girlsperm) playing guitarless, clattering, drum-and-keyboard punk — Post Present Medium's 2023 LP 'Lost to the Fantasy.'

artist_notes.name: The Intima
artist_notes.note: Portland post-punk quartet, violin-driven, active 1999-2004 and recently reunited — shared stages with The Rapture and The Mekons back in the day; PPM reissued their 'Peril and Panic' LP.

enrichment.curator_note: Three nights deep into Post Present Medium's 25th-anniversary run and this one's genuinely stacked — Abe Vigoda's tropical-punk reunion, Callahan & Witscher's weird new pivot into actual songs, and DIY lifers Debt Rag and reunited Portland post-punk act The Intima. This is the Smell's classic guitars-and-noise lane, not the club side of things.
enrichment.description: Night three of The Smell's Post Present Medium 25th-anniversary celebration: reunited LA tropical-punk band Abe Vigoda, experimental duo Callahan & Witscher, Olympia's Debt Rag, and reunited Portland post-punk band The Intima.

events.title: Mezzanine: Rob Tregenza's Talking to Strangers (1988)

artist_notes.name: Rob Tregenza
artist_notes.note: American structuralist filmmaker — Talking to Strangers (1988) is his triple-threat debut (writer/director/cinematographer): nine unbroken 10-minute 35mm takes, shot once each, sequenced by computer-randomized order. The NYT called it an antidote to jazzy montage; a genuine formalist curio, not a normal narrative feature.

enrichment.curator_note: This is about as structurally radical as rep programming gets — nine single-take, ten-minute 35mm shots, filmed once apiece, no coverage. Not a comfortable watch, but exactly the kind of print/format-driven booking the Mezzanine series exists for.
enrichment.description: 2220 Arts + Archives' Mezzanine series screens Rob Tregenza's Talking to Strangers (1988), a formally radical nine-take 35mm feature.

artist_notes.name: A Club Called Rhonda

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Azzecca, Afriqua, Ray Kash

artist_notes.name: Afriqua
artist_notes.note: Adam Longman Parker — Virginia-born, Berlin-based producer on R&S Records; his 2019 LP 'Colored' fused deep house/techno with an explicit Black-culture lens. A genuinely respected, thoughtful name — arguably the most substantive booking on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Azzecca
artist_notes.note: Chicago DJ/producer (Allie DeCastris) and COSIMEA label boss — cosmic, dark, disco-inflected house/techno; a Beatport 'Next Artist' for 2025 who's shared bills with Tale of Us and CamelPhat.

artist_notes.name: Ray Kash
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture since 2010 (Temple Tuesdays resident) — deep house into techno and melodic, weaned on Danny Tenaglia/Jonathan Peters-style New York house.

enrichment.curator_note: Afriqua alone is worth the trip to DTLA — R&S-signed, one of the more substantive deep house/techno voices around — and Azzecca/Ray Kash round it into a real groove-forward bill rather than another generic warehouse night.
enrichment.description: DTLA club date led by R&S producer Afriqua, with Chicago's Azzecca and LA local Ray Kash.

artist_notes.name: Oguz
artist_notes.note: Dutch-Turkish techno DJ/producer — high-tempo, hard-driving peak-time techno, a regular on the international festival/club circuit. Refined-end-of-techno rather than melodic.

enrichment.curator_note: Straight peak-time techno at Exchange LA's Mutate series — no groove or daytime softness here, this is a full-tempo club night for when that's the mood.
enrichment.description: Mutate techno night at Exchange LA featuring Dutch-Turkish techno DJ Oguz.

events.title: Rival Consoles
events.detail: Teragram Ballroom presents: Rival Consoles with support from Khotin [August 22, 2026 / Doors 7pm / $25 advance / $30 day of show / All Ages]

artist_notes.name: Rival Consoles
artist_notes.note: Ryan Lee West — UK producer on Erased Tapes known for guitar-and-modular-laced, emotionally heavy electronic/ambient records ('Persona', 'Now Is'); closer to Jon Hopkins/Nils Frahm territory than a club DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Khotin
artist_notes.note: Edmonton producer (Dylan Khotin-Foote) on Ghostly International — warm, hazy ambient-house; a gentle, textural opener.

enrichment.curator_note: Not a club night — Rival Consoles is heady, modular-and-guitar electronic in the Jon Hopkins/Nils Frahm vein, and Khotin's hazy ambient-house is the right warm-up. A good pick if you want to actually sit and listen for once.
enrichment.description: Live electronic/ambient set from UK's Rival Consoles (Erased Tapes) with support from Ghostly International's Khotin at Teragram Ballroom.

events.title: RE/FORM presents Trip To Galaxy: Joris Voorn, LUIS MIRANDA, & Materielle

artist_notes.name: Joris Voorn
artist_notes.note: Dutch mainstay of melodic techno-house since the mid-2000s (his own Green and Rejected labels) — the 'Nobody Knows' album won Billboard's Electronic Album of the Year in 2014. Widescreen, emotive, festival-capable; not on the tracked list but a real headliner, closer to Solomun/Tale of Us than pure techno.

artist_notes.name: LUIS MIRANDA
artist_notes.note: Madrid-born, LA-based techno producer on Tronic and KD Raw — driving peak-time techno with real co-signs (Richie Hawtin, Rødhåd support his tracks); a legit local name, not filler support.

artist_notes.name: Materielle
artist_notes.note: LA techno producer/DJ steeped in '90s Detroit — dub-heavy, hypnotic, texture-first sets; still building a catalog (Delusi EPs) but a thoughtful selector.

enrichment.curator_note: Joris Voorn headlining a TBA-location night is a genuine catch — he's been putting out widescreen, emotive techno-house for two decades — and the local support here (Luis Miranda, Materielle) is real rather than an afterthought.

events.title: INCOGNITO presents Paolo Ferrara - LA Debut (Extended Set), Elise Ember and KriStyle

artist_notes.name: Paolo Ferrara
artist_notes.note: Italian 'Heavy Destroyer' behind TechnoMetal — hard techno fused with metal aggression and industrial noise, co-founder of the HEX movement; his 'Last Resort' hit #1 on Beatport's Hard Techno chart in 2024. A much harder, more extreme booking than the rooftop-groove lane, closer to Sara Landry's crowd.

events.detail: FESTIVAL | From $250 | All ages | Olivia Rodrigo's first festival — an all-women lineup at Great Park (Irvine), 100% of net proceeds to nonprofits supporting women & girls. With Chappell Roan, Doechii, KATSEYE, Mitski, The Breeders, Bikini Kill, Garbage, Santigold, Die Spitz, Rachel Chinouriri, Quiet Light, Eli, Not For Radio + special guests Stevie Nicks, Karen O, Sarah McLachlan. artist_notes.name: Die Spitz

enrichment.curator_note: Olivia Rodrigo's first festival is a genuinely stacked, curated bill — Bikini Kill next to Mitski next to Stevie Nicks is a real lineup, not just a pop show — but it's Irvine on a Saturday and this isn't the electronic lane at all, so it's more 'worth knowing about' than 'worth the drive' unless the day is already built around it.

verdict.why: Olivia Rodrigo's all-women debut festival puts two tracked artists (Olivia, Mitski) on the same bill as Bikini Kill, The Breeders, Garbage, Karen O, and Stevie Nicks — worth the Irvine drive for any one of them; together this is the show of the season.

events.title: Haddaway, Ultra Naté, Robin S, Crystal Waters & More

artist_notes.name: Ultra Naté
artist_notes.note: Baltimore club/house vocalist behind '90s anthem 'Free' — a real voice of that Yoshitoshi/Deep Dish-adjacent house era, not a manufactured pop act.

artist_notes.name: Crystal Waters
artist_notes.note: NYC deep-house vocalist — 'Gypsy Woman (She's Homeless)' and '100% Pure Love,' both Basement Boys productions, are genuine foundational house-anthem catalog.

artist_notes.name: Robin S
artist_notes.note: UK house vocalist whose 'Show Me Love' (1993) is one of the most sampled/replayed piano-house records ever — a real genre landmark even if the name itself isn't a household one.

enrichment.curator_note: This is a house-legends day party, not a tribute act — Haddaway, Ultra Naté, Robin S and Crystal Waters all made the actual records, so a free outdoor DTLA stage is a genuinely good way to hear 'Show Me Love' and 'Gypsy Woman' from the people who made them.
enrichment.description: Outdoor '90s house-classics day party at Pershing Square with original vocalists Haddaway, Ultra Naté, Robin S and Crystal Waters.

events.detail: The winner of four 2024 Tony Awards®, including Best Musical, is THE OUTSIDERS.Adapted from S.E. Entertainment Weekly says, "THE OUTSIDERS has the power to inspire an entire generation."In Tulsa, Oklahoma, 1967, Ponyboy Curtis, his best friend Johnny Cade and their Greaser family of ‘outsiders’ battle with their affluent rivals, the Socs. THE OUTSIDERS navigates the complexities of self- discovery as the Greasers dream about who they want to become in a world that may never accept them. With a dynamic original score, THE OUTSIDERS is a story of friendship, family, belonging…and the realization that there is still “lots of good in the world.”

events.title: Bonnie Raitt: Live 2026 with Special Guest Jon Cleary
lineup: Jon Cleary & the Absolute Monster Gentlemen
events.detail: Bluesy singer/songwriter Bonnie Raitt has worked long and hard for her multiple Grammy Awards, hit singles and chart-topping records. Since her 1971 eponymous debut, the California-born performer and long-time activist has steadily maintained a music career, albeit with definite peaks and valleys. The red-headed songstress, one of the only women of her time to play guitar using the bottleneck technique, unleashed seven albums in just nine years, though her big commercial break came with her 10th studio set, 1989’s “Nick of Time.” That 11-track collection, produced by Don Was, earned three Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year. Not only has the Rock and Roll Hall of Famer tackled multiple U.S. tours and international runs, but she’s also a frequent participant in events of social activism, such as Farm Aid and Amnesty International concerts. Raitt’s 16th full-length album and most recent studio release, “Slipstream,” hit retailers in 2012. Not only did ticket sales for the support tour soar, but Raitt also landed the best-selling blues album of the year and took home the Grammy for Best Americana Album.

profile.taste_yaml:
# Taste profile — Lori (dashboard profile-switcher, username: lori).
#
# Lori is a young ethnomusicologist with a deep, knowledgeable, genuinely diverse ear: her
# range runs from the Stooges to Olivia Rodrigo — proto-punk / garage / post-punk through craft
# pop, and a real appetite for global / diaspora / traditional music (desert blues, Latin alt,
# cumbia, Afro-funk, jazz, folk). She's a LIVE-MUSIC head first — bands over DJs — and she's based
# in Glendale (East LA). Electronic is welcome but secondary. Mechanism (geo + weights) lives in
# profiles/lori/profile.yaml. Edit this, then: python scripts/build_profiles.py --only lori

categories:
  high:
    # +3
    - live bands across the spectrum — garage / proto-punk / post-punk / indie /
      art-rock / experimental in intimate clubs (Zebulon, The Echo, Lodge Room,
      Teragram, Gold Diggers)
    - global / diaspora / traditional & roots music — desert blues, Latin
      alternative, cumbia, Afro-funk, highlife, Anatolian/psych, world & folk
      traditions (the ethnomusicologist core)
    - jazz, soul, funk & live-band nights in listening rooms and small clubs
      (ETA, Gold Line)
    - craft / songwriter pop with a point of view (Olivia Rodrigo, Mitski,
      Caroline Polachek tier)
    - classic rock
    - goth
    - alternative
    - indie
    - grunge
    - punk
  medium:
    # +2
    - rep & arthouse cinema (Vidiots, Vista, New Beverly, Cinematheque, Aero,
      Alex Theatre)
    - record fairs, listening bars, vinyl nights, in-stores & album-listening
      events
    - cultural / heritage programming — museum nights, music-doc screenings,
      talks & performances
    - daytime & lifestyle — flea / vintage / record / design markets, farmers
      markets, street fairs
    - theater & performing arts (black-box through Pantages / Ahmanson scale)
  low:
    # +1, only if exceptional
    - DJ sets / electronic in a chill, musical, listening-forward setting (not
      the main thing)
    - big-room / festival EDM and warehouse techno — only a marquee, genuinely
      special name

boosts:
  # +1 each (stack)
  - intimate / seated / listening-room setting
  - vinyl / all-analog presentation, record-store & in-store shows
  - walkable or short drive from Glendale / the Eastside (NELA, Atwater, Los
    Feliz, Pasadena)
  - Friday or Saturday night
  - independent editorial mention (LAist, Time Out, DiscoverLA, KCRW)
  - outdoor / garden / sunset setting

penalties:
  # -2 each
  - bottle-service / table-service nightclubs
  - generic Top-40 / open-format club nights with no real billing
  - tribute / cover bands and "[decade] night" nostalgia nights
  - far-flung (OC / SD / Temecula / Ventura / Long Beach) unless genuinely worth
    the trip

# Match in a lineup => +2 and a "tracked" badge. Curated across her range — proto-punk & garage,
# indie / art-rock, craft pop, and the global / diaspora / jazz spine an ethnomusicologist lives in.
artists_tracked:
  # proto-punk / garage / punk (the Stooges end)
  - Iggy Pop
  - The Stooges
  - Osees
  - Ty Segall
  - King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard
  - Parquet Courts
  - Viagra Boys
  - Fontaines D.C.
  - Idles
  # indie / art-rock / post-punk
  - black midi
  - Black Country, New Road
  - Big Thief
  - Cate Le Bon
  - Weyes Blood
  - Angel Olsen
  - Sharon Van Etten
  - Dry Cleaning
  # craft / songwriter pop (the Olivia Rodrigo end)
  - Olivia Rodrigo
  - Mitski
  - Caroline Polachek
  - Japanese Breakfast
  - Faye Webster
  - boygenius
  - Alanis Morissette # 90s confessional alt-rock — the ancestor of the craft-pop lane; arena tours
  # global / diaspora / Latin alt / desert blues (the ethnomusicologist spine)
  - Chicano Batman
  - Hermanos Gutiérrez
  - Khruangbin
  - Mdou Moctar
  - Tinariwen
  - Bombino
  - Altın Gün
  - Combo Chimbita
  - Meridian Brothers
  - Helado Negro
  - Y La Bamba
  - Hurray for the Riff Raff
  # jazz / soul / funk (LA scene)
  - Kamasi Washington
  - Thundercat
  - BadBadNotGood
  - Adrian Younge
  - Kacey Musgraves
  - Grateful Dead
  - David Bowie
  - Lauryn Hill

comedians_loved: []
venues_loved:
  [
    Alex Theatre,
    Zebulon,
    Lodge Room,
    ETA,
    Permanent Records Roadhouse,
    The Echo,
    Teragram Ballroom,
    The Greek,
    Gold Line,
    Masonic Lodge at Hollywood Forever
  ]

feedback:
  - "2026-06-20: ethnomusicologist; diverse, knowledgeable taste — Stooges to
    Olivia Rodrigo. Bands & live music over electronic. Based in Glendale
    (Eastside geo). Don't penalize genre breadth (hip-hop, bass, etc. are fine);
    penalize only bottle-service clubs / cover bands / junk."
  - "2026-06-26: Added Kacey Musgraves, Grateful Dead, David Bowie, and Lauryn
    Hill to tracked artists. (self-edit via concierge)"
  - "2026-07-06: Added classic rock, goth, alternative, indie, grunge, and punk
    as high-interest genres. (self-edit via concierge)"
profile.profile_yaml:
# profile.yaml — MECHANISM config for Lori's dashboard feed (username: lori).
# Mirrors the root profile.yaml schema; only the lanes that actually differ from Ari's are
# changed. Lori is band/live-music-forward (not an electronic head) with a knowledgeable,
# diverse, ethnomusicologist's ear, and she's based in Glendale (East LA) — so the geo,
# category weights, and penalties are retuned for her. taste.yaml = CONTENT; this = MECHANISM.

city: Los Angeles
timezone: America/Los_Angeles

# Home base — Glendale (drives the "close to home" boost + night-planner travel times).
home:
  neighborhood: Glendale
  cross_streets: Brand & Broadway
  coords: [34.1469, -118.2554]   # central Glendale; used by scripts/lib/geo.py

sources:
  ticketmaster_dma_id: "324"   # LA DMA
  ra_area_id: 23               # RA's LA area number

scoring:
  # Band/live-music-forward. Live music is the top lane; electronic is welcome but secondary
  # (she's "more into bands than electronic", not anti-electronic). Pop is a real lane
  # (Olivia Rodrigo); art bumped for the ethnomusicologist's cultural appetite.
  category_weights:
    music: 3          # live music (catalog's term) — her spine
    live_music: 3
    pop: 2            # craft pop (Olivia Rodrigo tier)
    film: 2           # rep & arthouse cinema
    theater: 2
    beer_food: 2
    art: 2            # cultural / heritage / museum programming
    electronic: 2     # secondary, not unwelcome — a good DJ/live-electronic act still counts
    party: 1          # club / warehouse / afterhours — not her scene
    comedy: 1
    general: 1

  rating_thresholds:
    - [8, 5]
    - [6, 4]
    - [4, 3]
    - [2, 2]

  # Walkable / short drive from Glendale (+1). Glendale-centric Eastside / NELA / valley radius.
  near_home_neighborhoods:
    - glendale
    - atwater village
    - atwater
    - los feliz
    - silver lake
    - silverlake
    - echo park
    - eagle rock
    - highland park
    - glassell park
    - mount washington
    - cypress park
    - lincoln heights
    - east hollywood
    - hollywood
    - burbank
    - toluca lake
    - north hollywood
    - noho arts district
    - pasadena
    - south pasadena
    - downtown
    - dtla
    - chinatown

  # +1: setting boost retuned for a band-head — rewards intimate / analog / outdoor rooms,
  # NOT afterhours DJ parties. (Dropped "groove"/"disco"/"all night" etc., which were inflating
  # electronic afters — "groove" even substring-matched "Groovers Inn".)
  groove_terms:
    - vinyl
    - all-analog
    - all analog
    - listening
    - record store
    - in-store
    - rooftop
    - sunset
    - golden hour
    - open-air
    - open air
    - outdoor
    - garden
    - patio

  # European house-label boost is electronic-scene specific and largely irrelevant to her;
  # kept inert (a token that won't match) so the engine doesn't fall back to Ari's label list.
  eu_terms:
    - __no_eu_boost__

  # -2 each. Pared down from Ari's list: NO hip-hop / dubstep / hardstyle / EDM-genre penalties
  # (she's a diverse, knowledgeable music head — genre breadth is the point). Kept: the genuinely
  # off-taste stuff (bottle-service clubs, generic no-billing Top-40 nights, tribute/cover/decade
  # nostalgia) and the non-music junk.
  penalty_terms:
    - bottle service
    - bottle-service
    - vip table
    - table service
    - top 40
    - top-40
    - open format
    - open-format
    - tribute
    - cover band
    - watch party
    - world cup
    - fifa
    - sports bar
    - trivia
    - bingo
    - karaoke
    - networking
    - webinar
    - virtual
    - zoom

  # -2: far-flung from Glendale (not worth the trip by default).
  far_terms:
    - anaheim
    - santa ana
    - irvine
    - san diego
    - temecula
    - ventura
    - riverside
    - long beach
    - costa mesa
    - huntington beach

  # Spotify + feedback music layer (Phase C) — same mechanics as root; inert until Lori has a
  # Spotify artifact / feedback log of her own. Enriches taste.yaml, never overwrites it.
  spotify:
    tier_points:
      core: 3
      strong: 2
      light: 1
      hidden: -3
    artist_cap: 5
    genre_points: 1
    genre_threshold: 0.5
    genre_cap: 1
    min_name_len: 3
    ambiguous_names: [train, future, juice, jungle, lights, justice, work, sanctuary, paradise,
                      chance, hold, alive]

  feedback:
    weights:
      loved: 2.0
      went: 1.5
      clicked_ticket: 0.5
      added_calendar: 0.5
      skipped: -0.5
      hide: -10.0

# Travel / geography for the night-planner (scripts/lib/geo.py) — same tunables as root.
geo:
  travel:

+# profile.yaml — MECHANISM config for Lori's dashboard feed (username: lori).
+# Mirrors the root profile.yaml schema; only the lanes that actually differ from Ari's are
+# changed. Lori is band/live-music-forward (not an electronic head) with a knowledgeable,
+# diverse, ethnomusicologist's ear, and she's based in Glendale (East LA) — so the geo,
+# category weights, and penalties are retuned for her. taste.yaml = CONTENT; this = MECHANISM.
+
+city: Los Angeles
+timezone: America/Los_Angeles
+
+# Home base — Glendale (drives the "close to home" boost + night-planner travel times).
+home:
+  neighborhood: Glendale
+  cross_streets: Brand & Broadway
+  coords: [34.1469, -118.2554]   # central Glendale; used by scripts/lib/geo.py
+
+sources:
+  ticketmaster_dma_id: "324"   # LA DMA
+  ra_area_id: 23               # RA's LA area number
+
+scoring:
+  # Band/live-music-forward. Live music is the top lane; electronic is welcome but secondary
+  # (she's "more into bands than electronic", not anti-electronic). Pop is a real lane
+  # (Olivia Rodrigo); art bumped for the ethnomusicologist's cultural appetite.
+  category_weights:
+    music: 3          # live music (catalog's term) — her spine
+    live_music: 3
+    pop: 2            # craft pop (Olivia Rodrigo tier)
+    film: 2           # rep & arthouse cinema
+    theater: 2
+    beer_food: 2
+    art: 2            # cultural / heritage / museum programming
+    electronic: 2     # secondary, not unwelcome — a good DJ/live-electronic act still counts
+    party: 1          # club / warehouse / afterhours — not her scene
+    comedy: 1
+    general: 1
+
+  rating_thresholds:
+    - [8, 5]
+    - [6, 4]
+    - [4, 3]
+    - [2, 2]
+
+  # Walkable / short drive from Glendale (+1). Glendale-centric Eastside / NELA / valley radius.
+  near_home_neighborhoods:

+  # +1: setting boost retuned for a band-head — rewards intimate / analog / outdoor rooms,
